## LLM systems and evaluation

::: {.project}
<div class="item-meta">2024<br>Production RAG</div>
<div class="item-body"><strong>Wandbot: an evaluation-driven refactor</strong><br>Reworked W&B's open-source documentation assistant around systematic evaluation. Answer accuracy rose from 72% to 81%, latency fell by 84%, and a full evaluation run went from roughly two hours to under ten minutes. Nearly 50 experiments made the trade-offs between quality, speed, and cost visible.<span class="item-links">[Read the case study](http://wandb.me/wandbot-refactor) · [Source](https://github.com/wandb/wandbot)</span><span class="tag">RAG</span><span class="tag">Evaluation</span><span class="tag">Production</span></div>
:::

::: {.project}
<div class="item-meta">2023<br>LLM evaluation</div>
<div class="item-body"><strong>Evaluating, comparing, and optimizing LLM systems</strong><br>Built a workflow for comparing system configurations with human labels, LLM judges, retrieval metrics, and parameter search.<span class="item-links">[Technical report](https://wandb.ai/ayush-thakur/llm-eval-sweep/reports/How-to-Evaluate-Compare-and-Optimize-LLM-Systems--Vmlldzo0NzgyMTQz)</span><span class="tag">LLMOps</span><span class="tag">Evals</span></div>
:::

::: {.project}
<div class="item-meta">2023<br>Open source</div>
<div class="item-body"><strong>LlamaIndex × W&B</strong><br>Built W&B instrumentation for retrieval and LLM traces, debugging query pipelines, and versioning indexes and embeddings.<span class="item-links">[Walkthrough](https://wandb.ai/ayush-thakur/llama-index-report/reports/Building-Advanced-Query-Engine-and-Evaluation-with-LlamaIndex-and-W-B--Vmlldzo0OTIzMjMy)</span><span class="tag">LlamaIndex</span><span class="tag">Tracing</span></div>
:::
